mapper.insert: insert into led_receipt (tenant_id, id, unit_id, sid, method, channel, amount, paid_at, status, toss_payment_key, toss_order_id, approval_no, card_issuer, installment, terminal_id, share_eligible, recorded_by, diff_reason, idem_key, charge_ids, link_hash) values (#{tid}, #{id}, #{unit}, #{sid}, #{method}, #{channel}, #{amount}, case when #{paidAt}::text is null then null else #{paidAt}::timestamptz end, #{status}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, #{approvalNo}, #{cardIssuer}, #{installment}::smallint, #{terminalId}, #{share}, #{by}, #{diffReason}, #{idem}, case when #{chargeCsv}::text is null then null else string_to_array(#{chargeCsv}, ',') end, #{linkHash})

select id, bill_id, unit_id, item_type, amount, status, to_char(created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as d from led_charge where tenant_id = #{tid} and (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date

select id, unit_id, amount, method, status, share_eligible, to_char(paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as d from led_receipt where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'paid' and (paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date

select f.id, f.amount, f.status, f.receipt_id, r.unit_id, r.share_eligible, to_char(coalesce(f.done_at, f.at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as d from led_refund f join led_receipt r on r.tenant_id = f.tenant_id and r.id = f.receipt_id where f.tenant_id = #{tid} and f.status = 'done' and (coalesce(f.done_at, f.at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date

select 'charge' as "type", id, unit_id as "unit", sid, item_type as "itemType", title, amount, status, to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', ) as "at", to_char(due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "dueDate", bill_id as "bill" from led_charge where tenant_id = #{tid} and (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date

select 'receipt' as "type", id, unit_id as "unit", sid, method, channel, amount, status, to_char(coalesce(paid_at, created_at) at time zone 'UTC', ) as "at", approval_no as "approvalNo", diff_reason as "diffReason", corrects, legacy_ref as "legacyRef", share_eligible as "shareEligible" from led_receipt where tenant_id = #{tid} and (coalesce(paid_at, created_at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date

select 'refund' as "type", f.id, r.unit_id as "unit", r.sid, f.receipt_id as "receipt", f.amount, f.status, to_char(coalesce(f.done_at, f.at) at time zone 'UTC', ) as "at", f.rule_type as "ruleType", f.legacy_ref as "legacyRef" from led_refund f join led_receipt r on r.tenant_id = f.tenant_id and r.id = f.receipt_id where f.tenant_id = #{tid} and (coalesce(f.done_at, f.at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date

select coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where method = 'cash'), 0)::int as cash, coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where method = 'desk_card'), 0)::int as card from led_receipt where tenant_id = #{tid} and unit_id = #{unit} and status = 'paid' and (paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = #{day}::date

select coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where r.method = 'cash'), 0)::int as cash, coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where r.method = 'desk_card'), 0)::int as card from led_refund f join led_receipt r on r.tenant_id = f.tenant_id and r.id = f.receipt_id where f.tenant_id = #{tid} and r.unit_id = #{unit} and f.status = 'done' and (f.done_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = #{day}::date

select id, unit_id, to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, cash_system, cash_counted, card_system, card_counted, diff_reason, closed_by, to_char(closed_at at time zone 'UTC', ) as closed_at from led_close where tenant_id = #{tid} and unit_id = #{unit} and day = #{day}::date
mapper.insert: insert into led_close (tenant_id, id, unit_id, day, cash_system, cash_counted, card_system, card_counted, diff_reason, closed_by) values (#{tid}, #{id}, #{unit}, #{day}::date, #{cs}, #{cc}, #{ks}, #{kc}, #{why}, #{by})
mapper.update: update led_receipt set close_id = #{id} where tenant_id = #{tid} and unit_id = #{unit} and status = 'paid' and close_id is null and (paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = #{day}::date

mapper.select: select id, unit_id as "unit", label, mode, to_char(last_seen at time zone 'UTC', ) as "lastSeen", to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', ) as "createdAt" from led_device where tenant_id = #{tid} order by created_at
